response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong software development expertise with a broad technical background, including geospatial projects (GISCollective) and low-latency systems. While his primary experience is in TypeScript/Node.js, his work with Dlang, C++, and distributed systems aligns partially with the role's requirements. His open-source contributions and problem-solving approach are assets, though his direct routing/navigation experience is limited.
strengths: Extensive experience with geospatial data platforms (GISCollective) and open-source contributions in the domain.
Proven track record in building scalable, low-latency systems (e.g., Sociomantic, Dunnhumby) using distributed-system concepts.
Strong problem-solving and experimentation mindset, evidenced by workshops and technical talks.
concerns: Primary expertise in TypeScript/Node.js, with limited recent commercial C++/Rust experience (critical for this role).
No explicit experience with routing tiles, navigation systems, or real-time traffic integration in the resume.
Broad but varied career path may raise questions about depth in geospatial data pipelines.
